brief:
Settlers attacked the Bedouin community of Khan al-Ahmar east of occupied Jerusalem, throwing stones at residents and agricultural installations while Israeli occupation forces provided protection, Shehab Wire reported.

The assault targeted the settlement's structures and population in what residents characterize as a coordinated operation between settlers and the military. Khan al-Ahmar, located in Area C of the occupied West Bank under full Israeli control, has faced repeated pressure from Israeli authorities and settlers seeking its removal.
